recipe.title: Garlic Soy Butter Noodles
recipe.source_summary: The creator fries garlic in butter, builds a soy-honey sauce, and tosses it with boiled noodles and scallions.

steps.text: Boil the noodles in salted water until just tender, then drain.
steps.visual_cue: noodles loose and glossy, no white core

steps.text: Melt the butter in a pan over medium heat.
steps.visual_cue: butter fully melted with light foam, not browned

steps.text: Add minced garlic and fry until fragrant and pale golden.
steps.visual_cue: garlic pale golden at the edges, not brown

steps.text: Pour in the soy sauce and honey, stir to combine.
common_mistakes: too much soy, sauce turns salty

steps.text: Add chili flakes and simmer until the sauce thickens slightly.
steps.visual_cue: sauce coats the spoon, small slow bubbles

steps.text: Toss the drained noodles in the sauce until fully coated.
steps.visual_cue: every strand glossy brown, no sauce pooling
common_mistakes: adding wet noodles, sauce goes thin

steps.text: Plate and top with sliced scallions.
steps.visual_cue: noodles piled high with green scallions on top

warnings: Hot pan: sauce will spit when it hits the butter.
